title: Vanilla Enchanted+
description: A modpack that enhances the Vanilla Minecraft experience
body:
# Vanilla Enchanted+
A simple modpack that enhances the overall Vanilla Minecraft experience by adding fancy features and performance add-ons!

_**Disclaimer:** I do not own any of these mods and the rights go to their respective owners._

## List of mods
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) by [jellysquid3](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3)
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) by [jellysquid3](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3)
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) by [malte0811](https://modrinth.com/user/malte0811)
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) by [tr7zw](https://modrinth.com/user/tr7zw)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) by [Terraformers](https://modrinth.com/organization/terraformers)
- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) by [jeseibel](https://modrinth.com/user/jeseibel)
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) by [coderbot](https://modrinth.com/user/coderbot)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) by [modmuss50](https://modrinth.com/user/modmuss50)
